subject: Marketplace inquiry - demo & availability
messages:
From: Tara Li <tara.li@cloudvertex.com>
To: marketplace@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Intro / Demo request from marketplace listing

Hi Redwood team,

We came across your listing in the CloudMarketplace and signed up for a trial. We're evaluating inference platforms for low-latency customer-facing features (multimodal prompts, embeddings for search). I'd like to set up a short intro + demo — someone from our infra/security may join.

High level info:
- Company: CloudVertex (SaaS)
- Primary region: us-west
- Expected peak QPS: ~50 requests/sec initially
- Data types: text + short audio transcripts

Can you share availability this week or next? Also curious whether you can do a brief walkthrough of Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs and any trial credits for testing production-like workloads.

Thanks,
Tara Li
Senior Platform PM
CloudVertex
T: +1 (415) 555-0198

---

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Li <tara.li@cloudvertex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro / Demo request from marketplace listing

Hi Tara — thanks for reaching out and welcome to Redwood. I'm Dylan on the marketplace SDR team. Happy to get a 30-min intro scheduled and tailor it to the areas you called out (latency, Dedicated vs Hosted, and trial/credits).

A couple quick Qs so we pull the right team and prep a short agenda:
- Is the Proof-of-Concept a public-facing feature or internal tooling? (affects telemetry/retention needs)
- Do you have a preferred stack for model integration (REST SDK, private deployment, or via our marketplace connector)?
- Any compliance constraints we should know up front (SOC2, data residency, or specific encryption/HSM needs)?

My availability (PST) — pick one or suggest alternatives:
- Tue 11/03 10:00–10:30
- Tue 11/03 14:00–14:30
- Wed 11/04 09:00–09:30

If you confirm a time I'll loop in Marissa (solutions engineer) to run the demo and include an invite. I've attached a short pre-demo checklist (pre-demo-checklist.pdf) that helps us tailor the session.

Calendly: https://cal.redwood.ai/d/dylan-30m

Best,
Dylan Brooks
SDR | Redwood Inference
